artworks.title: The Universe is Created (L'Univers est cree)
artworks.description: The image displays flowing lines and shapes that swirl and stretch across the canvas. The design incorporates a play of colors and forms, possibly resembling elements from nature such as rolling hills, leaves, or mountains merging with abstracted figures. A central shape is reminiscent of a creature's head or a mask with an elongated nose and intricate patterned decoration resembling a ceremonial headdress. The use of earthy colors and swirling lines conveys the fluidity of natural landscapes within a dynamic and abstract representation.

artworks.title: An Arabian Horse
artworks.description: The image shows a person standing beside a horse. The person has one arm over the horse's neck and the other hand holding the horse's halter. The person's facial expression is calm. They are wearing traditional clothing, including loose-fitting trousers and a long top or robe, with a turban on their head. There are no visible accessories or jewelry on the person. The background shows a desert landscape with a tent, seated figures, and palm trees, suggesting a desert camp. The image is in sepia tone.

artworks.title: Groom Mounted on a Carriage-Horse (Cheval de carrosse monte par un palfrenier)
artworks.description: The image shows a man on a horse. The man is sitting upright on the horse, looking to the side. He has a hat, short hair, and is wearing a dark jacket, light trousers, and boots. He holds the reins with both hands. The horse wears a saddle and bridle, with its head turned slightly to the side. The background includes a wall and a textured surface.

artworks.title: The Coal Waggon
artworks.description: The image shows a side view of a large coal wagon being pulled by a team of four horses on a dirt road. The wagon, horses, and surroundings are depicted in pencil sketch with detailed textures.

artworks.title: A Party of Life Guards
artworks.description: Two figures in military attire are depicted conversing. On the left, a person on horseback with one arm resting on their thigh, wearing a tall helmet with a plume, a detailed jacket, and boots is shown. The figure has distinct facial features and a firm expression. On the right, another figure stands beside a horse, facing the seated figure, wearing a similar helmet, a cross-body sash, a jacket, and high boots, holding an object resembling a sword. The background features faint sketches of additional horse-mounted figures, blending into a lightly shaded backdrop, suggesting an informal military setting. The image has a monochromatic tone, enhancing its historical and formal appearance.

artworks.title: Grasp All, Lose All (Qui trop embrasse, mal etrient)
artworks.description: The image shows a nude person walking up a slope, carrying large objects like tools and scrolls. They have short, curly hair and visible facial features in profile. Over their right shoulder is a cherubic figure, a small winged child facing the viewer. Around the person's feet lies drapery. The background includes a decorative column, foliage, trees, and a lightly sketched sky.

artworks.title: Four Magistrates of Besançon (Quatre magistrats de Besançon)
artworks.description: The image shows a drawing of four men seated on ornate chairs. The two men on the outer edges have one leg crossed over the other, while the two in the middle sit facing slightly towards each other. The central figure points with his right hand towards the person on his left. Their facial features include groomed beards and mustaches, and each man wears headwear ranging from crowns to hats with feathers. They wear period-style clothing with robes, tunics, fur elements, and elaborate patterns. Some men wear rings and necklaces. The setting is a luxurious interior with a detailed tapestry backdrop featuring a double-headed eagle emblem above the central figure and Latin text "Plus Ultra" etched into the fabric. The area is draped with curtains, decorated with heraldic shields, and the flooring displays intricate patterns.

artworks.title: Environs de Dieppe
artworks.description: The image shows a coastal scene with large cliffs on the left side and thatched-roof huts at their base. The horizon line is in the upper part of the image, meeting a stormy sky. The ocean below has dynamic patterns, a boat is navigating the rough waters. The color scheme consists of deep, muted tones, creating a moody atmosphere.

artworks.title: Marée Basse
artworks.description: The image shows a ship stranded on a shoreline at low tide. The ship is on a sandy and mud-streaked surface, with its sails down and masts reaching into a cloudy sky. Smaller figures or structures are visible on the distant shoreline, while nautical objects like ropes and crates are scattered around. The precise linework contrasts with the soft clouds above, and the monochromatic color palette adds a somber mood. The overall effect is one of stillness and quietude.

artworks.title: Eglise Saint-Jean, Thiers
artworks.description: The image shows an ancient structure on a rocky cliff, with hazy mountains in the background and a cloudy sky. The scene displays detailed line work, capturing the terrain's ruggedness. The monochromatic color palette uses grays and blacks for depth and texture. The rocky surface is detailed with lines leading to the buildings, which feature intricate stonework and shadowing. In the distance, small figures can be seen on a pathway, adding a sense of scale and human presence.

artworks.title: Rue des Gras à Clermont
artworks.description: The image depicts a narrow street scene with older buildings lining both sides. The buildings have architectural features such as shutters and tiled roofs. In the distance, mountains can be seen between the buildings. The sky is filled with clouds drawn with cross-hatched brushstrokes. The scene is primarily in grayscale, emphasizing the linework and shading. Various figures and animals are present in the street, suggesting a marketplace setting.

artworks.title: Crépuscule poetique (Poetical Twilight)
artworks.medium: lithograph on chine collé on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a rural scene featuring a herd of sheep. The sheep are clustered around a figure in a hat who appears to be a shepherd. A line of trees extends from the right and frames the scene. The horizon is low, with a hint of it visible above the trees. The sky above has a twilight aesthetic, using a muted, monochromatic color palette of dark gray and black. The lithograph employs fine brushstrokes to capture a calm evening ambiance.

artworks.title: Holland Canal, near Rotterdam (Canal de Hollande, pres de Rotterdam (Hiver))
artworks.description: The image is a line drawing of a landscape with a low horizon. A windmill is seen in the distance on the right. The drawing style is sketchy with spontaneous brushstrokes for clouds and foliage. The color palette is monochromatic with black ink on a beige background. A figure is standing by the water, and some distant structures or trees are visible on the horizon. The sky dominates the image with swirling clouds.

artworks.title: A Haarlem
artworks.description: The image shows a windmill and boats on a calm canal, with buildings and trees in the background. The etching technique creates detailed lines in a limited color palette of browns and beiges. The scene conveys a serene and timeless atmosphere.

artworks.title: Line in Front of the Butcher Shop (Queue devant la boucherie)
artworks.description: This print is an abstract depiction of a group of people holding umbrellas. The people are indistinct, depicted with fine, dark lines and no visible limbs or features. Above them are numerous umbrellas. The people cast dark shadows on the ground. One section in the center of the print, in the middle of the group of people, is mostly blank, suggesting an area of light or reflection. The background is mostly blank, tan paper, with one section of vertical black lines behind the figures and umbrellas on the right.

artworks.title: Gauguin
artworks.medium: woodcut in black on Japan paper
artworks.description: The image shows an artistic representation of a man's face and upper body. He is in a seated position, with his elbow resting on a surface and his hand supporting his chin. The man appears contemplative with deep-set eyes, a prominent nose, and a slightly unkempt beard and mustache. His hair is short, wavy, and combed back. He is dressed in a dark, tailored jacket with well-defined lapels and holds a cigarette between his fingers. In the background, there is a sculpture of a woman in a bust-style. The overall image is detailed and filled with intricate lines and shading.

artworks.title: Music Title
artworks.description: The image displays a sketch of a house from an eye-level perspective. The house is behind a sloping path leading to the entrance. There is no distinct horizon line. The house has a prominent roof with visible roofing tiles, windows, and an open doorway. The sketch has loose, soft pencil strokes creating a textured representation. The color palette is monochromatic, using different shades of gray and black for depth and contrast. In the foreground, there is vegetation and steps guiding towards the house in a lush environment. The composition directs the viewer's gaze from the bottom corner upwards towards the entrance of the house.

artworks.title: Music Title
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a rustic entrance to a small building surrounded by foliage. The composition features a charming cottage with a thatched roof, partially covered by vines and bushes. The building has a stone staircase leading to an entrance, with a veranda supported by pillars. Shutters on the window above are open. The scene is enveloped by nature, with dense vegetation flanking the building, and a small wooden fence bordering the foreground, all captured in intricate detail with a delicate use of monochrome shading.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Man
artworks.description: The image is a sketch of a man's bust, focusing on his head and upper torso. The man faces slightly to his left, with a three-quarter view of his face showing a stern expression, prominent eyebrows, a full beard, and short dark hair. He wears a suit jacket over a shirt, suggesting a formal style typical of the era. The background is blank, and there are no visible jewelry or objects.

artworks.title: Béatrice
artworks.description: The image displays a side profile of a person's upper body, focusing on the head and neck. The individual has their head slightly tilted downward. Their facial features are gentle and indistinct, with the outline of the nose and lips subtly visible. The hair is styled simply, and the person's clothing is depicted with soft brush strokes. The background has a light, airy texture resembling clouds or mist in pastel shades. In the top right corner, there is a small, vibrant blue motif or logo. No jewelry or objects are visible.

artworks.title: Le Buddha
artworks.description: The image features an abstract composition with curved and linear forms. In the center, there is a circular shape surrounded by a swirling background. A figure appears from the left, draped in a cloak-like shape. Above, a circular halo-like form adds to the abstraction. The use of light and dark shades creates depth.

artworks.title: Tete d'Enfant avec Fleurs (Head of a Child with Flowers)
artworks.description: The image shows the head and partial upper body of a person in profile, facing slightly to the left. The person has soft facial features and light, wavy hair. The background is filled with abstract, decorative flourishes in light brown hues.

artworks.title: Vieux Chevalier (Old Knight)
artworks.description: This image depicts the upper bust of a person positioned in profile, with their head turned slightly downwards, looking away from the viewer. Their facial features include a prominent nose and long hair flowing down their back. They wear a dark garment. The background features a circular object to the left and a seated, winged creature on a ledge to the right, alongside decorative patterns. Various textures are present, suggesting a complex environment.

artworks.title: Seated Bather (Baigneuse assise)
artworks.description: The sketch shows a woman from the torso up. She is seated, with her left arm extended and her right arm resting on her lap. Her facial features are gentle, her gaze is down and to the right, and her long hair falls over her shoulders. She is depicted without clothing on the upper part of her body, draped in fabric from the midsection down. There are no visible jewelry or objects. The background has textured shading outlining her figure. The artist's signature is at the bottom right of the drawing.
